summary: Ecopetrol S.A., a Colombian oil and gas company, filed a Form 6-K announcing the second convening of bondholder meetings for its domestic public debt bonds issued in 2010 and 2013. The meetings are scheduled for September 4, 2026, to vote on a proposed merger by absorption where Ecopetrol (surviving company) will absorb Parque Solar Portón del Sol S.A.S. The merger was approved by Ecopetrol's shareholders on March 27, 2026. The first call meetings failed to reach quorum. Bondholders will consider the merger report, the bondholder representatives' opinion, and a Fitch Ratings opinion. The 2010 issuance, Series A, has an outstanding amount of COP 284,300 million (CPI-linked, CPI+4.90%, maturing Dec. 2040). Watch for bondholder approval and merger completion.
